we have chased and escalated it.","Bramble did not resend its dealer list; with the client's consent, we reused the April list.","Northmoor's May tape repeats the row for loan {{duplicate_loan}}, so we are holding the load until the servicer confirms it."]},{"heading":"Open questions","points":["Northmoor: we have sent a reminder and an escalation for the May servicer report.","Bramble: the roll-forward found a gap of {{gap}}, with {{missing_loans}} loans missing from the May tape; we are asking the servicer to explain them.","Bramble: the servicer report shows charge-offs {{charge_off_difference}} higher than the tape, with {{charge_off_loans}} loans charged off in the report but still live on the tape.","Kestrel: one investment's valuation is {{stale_days}} days old, which is older than the agreement allows.","Northmoor: we are asking the servicer to confirm the repeated row for loan {{duplicate_loan}} before we load the tape."]},{"heading":"Exclusions","points":["Bramble: we excluded {{ineligible_loans}} receivables worth {{ineligible}} as not eligible, and deducted {{concentration_excess}} of dealer concentration excess.","Bramble: the {{missing_loans}} loans missing from the tape stay out of the pool until the servicer explains them."]},{"heading":"Identifier changes","points":["There were no identifier changes on the client's facilities this month."]},{"heading":"Missing financials","points":["Nothing is outstanding: Bramble's Q1 statements and compliance certificate arrived before the due date."]},{"heading":"Waiting on an expert","points":["Bramble: leverage is over its maximum only if the affiliate guarantee counts, giving {{leverage_with_guarantee}}; once the expert's view arrives, the client may need to decide how to treat the guarantee.","Kestrel: loan-to-value is being assessed both with and without the post-quarter markdown, giving {{ltv_with_markdown}} if the markdown counts; the client may need to decide which basis applies."]}]}
